notes.title: Demo Update poste
notes.notes:
A new update was posted today, bringing the demo up to v.1346. This update includes lost of fixes and changes made for the core game and lots of changes focused on the zombie and infection mechanics for this title. We've posted a video on our YouTube channel discussing some of the progress we've made;

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zPy6twLcLQY

For this demo the zombie stats and behaviours have been change extensively. If you played it before, you'll find it plays much differently now. The zombies are still super tough, but players can make progress in some areas and the zombie behaviours are more in line with what players would expect from a zombie faction.

As always, we'd appreciate feedback on the game. Let us know what you think!
